label: check050
claim: Displayed quantities and weather classifications reproduce; 680 marginal-cold knots are excluded and availability remains unknown.
source_report_body:
CHECK050 complete: all 89 checked displayed quantities reproduce. Fixed-hull upper offsets at 100 m are −6.512/−3.040/−0.312/+1.786/+3.339 K; the conservative cold start remains about −10.5 K. The sampled MIL 10% hot case fails at every radius. R10 saturated-night payload reproduces at −82.280 kg.

Independently reoptimized 57,120 coupled and 5,200 frozen knots; checked 42,160 filed finite geometries and all three 2,027,245-point maps. No weather classification, least-set or zero-surface finite-status mismatch remains. Strict finite-knot masses agree within 0.00414 kg; night deposits within floating-point precision.

The exact ledger distinguishes interpolation differences up to 0.23814 kg, small heater quadrature differences, and 680 excluded marginal-cold knots. A checker interface-tolerance issue was corrected and retained in the audit. The broader gas sweep passes; the owner's exact scalar sampling/conventions remain an NFI.

Eight checker NFIs and all owner/inherited qualifications remain. Installed-hull SF and operational availability are null. No050 executable source was accessed; upstream040/048 authorship is disclosed. Numerical jobs used simjob, and all communication used the queue. No successor is named.
